messages:
eng-sre-bot: PAGER: Elevated 5xx rate and tail latency for inter-region routing (eu -> us-west) detected by synthetic probes. Starting incident thread. thread_ts=2172467890
Maya R (oncall): seeing it on the dashboard, errors spike ~08:03 UTC, 5xx from routing layer, starts ~08:01. Marking Sev=2 for now.
Carlos M (support): customer-reports: DocuBoard and AcmeSearch reporting timeouts; ticket IDs #4521, #4522.
Maya R (oncall): logs show "route-mismatch: pinned-region != chosen-region" on several requests. Could be reconciliation bug in region-affinity service.
Raj P (network): pulling routing-policy diffs now. I see a recent policy roll (08:00 UTC) that adjusted steering weights: latency-based -> prefer-eu for certain prefixes. Might be invert logic on tie.
Alice C (infra): any quick rollback option? We can pin traffic to last-known-good policy for affected prefix.
Maya R (oncall): do it. Applying fallback policy now: `redwoodctl routing apply --policy-id p-78f3 --fallback last-known-good`
eng-sre-bot: deploy-bot: rollout start p-78f3 -> fallback last-known-good by maya-r
Raj P (network): after applying fallback, I'm still seeing a subset (~12%) of requests routed to us-west when they should be eu. Flow trace shows header `X-Region-Affinity: eu` but chosen node is us-west. Means affinity header is being dropped or compared against wrong shard.
Maya R (oncall): can we force a short-term region pin at the edge? `edgectl set-affinity --prefix /v1/generate --region eu --ttl 60s`
Alice C (infra): applied edge pin for /v1/generate (60s). Monitoring.
Carlos M (support): customers see partial recovery, DocuBoard still reports ~25% failed requests.
Raj P (network): I pulled debug heap for affinity-service, saw a recent consumer change that flips precedence: code diff `affinityPriority = preferRoutingPolicy || pinnedRegion` — that OR should be `&&` in the new logic. Reproducer attached to internal gist.
Maya R (oncall): great catch. Rollback that consumer change? Who owns it?
Raj P (network): change authored by infra-team earlier today (Alice). Alice, can you stage rollback?
Alice C (infra): rolling back consumer change now. `git revert 4f2b9c` -> staging -> canary.
support-bot: Notifying affected customers: DocuBoard, AcmeSearch, and three other tenants.
Maya R (oncall): canary shows immediate drop in 5xx within 30s. Pushing rollback to prod now (manual approval by alice-c).
Alice C (infra): prod rollback applied at 08:11 UTC. Confirming config parity across regions.
Raj P (network): tracing shows affinity header respected post-rollback, routing matches pinned/eu as expected. Latency back to baseline.
Carlos M (support): updating customer tickets: DocuBoard sees success now, closing with note if they reappear they should reopen.
Maya R (oncall): current impact summary: ~3.2% of global requests affected at peak, primary root cause: incorrect boolean logic in affinity consumer change that inverted precedence for routing policy vs pinned-region. Secondary cause: rollout at 08:00 without sufficient canary coverage for multi-region affinity.
Maya R (oncall): mitigation timeline: 08:01 anomaly detected; 08:03 rollback decision; 08:05 applied edge pins; 08:11 full rollback completed; 08:15 incident declared resolved operationally.
eng-sre-bot: Incident metrics: 5xx rate returned to baseline at 08:12 UTC. Marking for postmortem.
Raj P (network): follow-ups: 1) add unit tests for affinity precedence, 2) expand canary to cross-region path testing, 3) add alarm for header-drop patterns.
Alice C (infra): I'll open PR with tests + canary config changes and link here.
Carlos M (support): I'll prepare customer-facing summary for CS and send to affected accounts.
Maya R (oncall): Handoff: I'm going offline in 20m. @Raj P please take lead for postmortem and follow-ups. I'll file the incident ticket and attach traces.
Raj P (network): ack. Setting owner: raj-p/postmortem-2172467890.
Maya R (oncall): final note: no data exfiltration, no long-lived degradations, please sign off when you confirm follow-ups scheduled.
Alice C (infra): signed. PR started: github.com/redwood/affinity-service/pull/142 - includes revert + test.
eng-sre-bot: Incident thread closed for live mitigation. Please move to postmortem channel when writeup is ready.
